entities.summary: Škofja Loka is a town in Slovenia. It is the economic, cultural, educational, and administrative center of the Municipality of Škofja Loka in Upper Carniola. It has about 12,000 inhabitants. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
